intro: In Goldshire, A Warrior's Training sends young warriors to Stormwind for lessons in battlefield endurance. Lyria Du Lac directs them to the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town, where veteran Harry Burlguard offers seasoned instruction.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've shown yourself to be a competent warrior, friend. But you're still young and have a lot to learn.

Speak with Harry Burlguard--he's usually in the Pig and Whistle tavern, in the Old Town of Stormwind. Harry is an old veteran and a good teacher. He can show you a few moves that'll keep you breathing longer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh ho! Have a drink with me, friend. You look tough on the outside, but let's see if your gut can handle a few mugs of the Pig and Whistle's strongest!!
Or... Were you here for a lesson?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
